units.source_text: 天色微明，远近事物隐隐可辨之时，源氏公子方才下车。

en.t: When the sky had begun to brighten faintly and things near and far could just be made out, Prince Genji finally stepped down from the carriage.

units.source_text: 室中临时打扫起来，倒也布置得清清爽爽。

en.t: The room had been hastily cleaned, yet it was arranged in a neat and refreshing way.

units.source_text: 守院人说：“当差的人都不在这里。

en.t: The caretaker of the residence said, "None of the attendants on duty are here.
I fear this will be very inconvenient."

units.source_text: 这人是公子亲信的家臣，曾经在左大臣邸内伺候。

en.t: This man was a trusted retainer of the prince and had once served in the residence of the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 他走近启请：“可否召唤几个熟手来？”

en.t: He came closer and respectfully asked, "Shall I call a few experienced people here?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“我是特地选定这没有人来的地方的。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "I chose this place precisely because no one comes here.

units.source_text: 只让你一人知道，不许向外泄露。”

en.t: Only you are to know about it; you must not let it leak outside."
He ordered the man to keep it secret.

units.source_text: 这人立刻去备办早粥，然而人手不够，张皇失措。

en.t: The man immediately went to prepare the morning porridge, but with too few hands to help, he was thrown into a fluster.

units.source_text: 源氏公子从来不曾住过这么荒凉的旅寓，现在除了和夕颜滔滔不绝地谈情之外，没有别的事可做。

en.t: Prince Genji had never stayed in such a desolate lodging before, and now there was nothing for him to do except speak endlessly of love with Yugao.
